about.label: About the author
biography: Federico Navarrete is a Spanish–Salvadoran technology strategist and cultural researcher who builds bridges between cultures through folklore. His experience living in Poland, Spain, and Luxembourg inspired him to bring Salvadoran legends to international readers.

His Spanish Mirrors project connects the legends of El Salvador, Spain, and North Africa through their shared symbols and human experiences. He has presented his work at embassies and Instituto Cervantes centers across three continents, including the 2026 SIEL International Book Fair in Rabat.
